national_news.title: PM Modi Inaugurates SEMICON India 2026 in New Delhi
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated SEMICON India 2026 at Yashobhoomi, New Delhi, under the theme 'Silicon to Systems: Building the Ecosystem'.
Outlay for India Semiconductor Mission (ISM) 2.0 has been expanded to $13.5 billion from $8 billion in its first phase, with 12 chip-making projects approved so far.
SEMICON 2.0 focuses on six core pillars including semiconductor design, machines and materials, compound fabrication, R&D, and supporting 200 chip design startups.

national_news.title: SEMICON 2.0 Targeted to Attract ₹1 Lakh Crore Investment
bullets: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated that SEMICON 2.0 is expected to generate around ₹1 lakh crore in investments and up to 1 lakh employment opportunities.
The initiative aims to scale technical training by partnering with international bodies such as Taiwan's Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI).
Building on SEMICON 1.0 where 400 universities teach chip design, the curriculum is being upgraded to enable students to undertake complete systems design.

national_news.title: India and Bhutan Launch Phase 2 of Cross-Border UPI Payments
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar launched the second phase of international UPI in Bhutan, completing two-way digital payment connectivity between both nations.
India extended the Nehru Wangchuck Scholarship Scheme for Bhutanese students and handed over 54 Made-in-India electric vehicles to support e-mobility in Bhutan.
Inaugurated the 65-bed Gyaltsuen Jetsun Pema Mother and Child Hospital in Mongar and laid the foundation stone for the 500 KW Lunana Hydropower Project.

national_news.title: India Asserts Right to Protect Energy Security Amid US Sanctions Bill
bullets: The Ministry of External Affairs affirmed that India will take all necessary measures to ensure energy security for its 140 crore citizens through diversified crude sourcing.
Statement comes after the US House of Representatives passed a bill authorizing up to 100% tariffs on countries procuring Russian crude oil.
The proposed US legislation targets Russia's energy sector, its shadow fleet of vessels, and seeks to enforce restrictions on major buyers like India and China.

national_news.title: Nationwide Seva Sankalp Abhiyaan begins marking 25 years of PM Modi's public service
bullets: BJP's month-long nationwide 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyaan' commenced to mark the completion of 25 years of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's public life and service.
The campaign runs until the 17th of next month, with the opening day observed as 'Seva Diwas' featuring nationwide blood donation camps.
The initiative reinforces the national goal of achieving 'Viksit Bharat' by 2047 under the leadership of Prime Minister Modi.

national_news.title: Meghalaya hosts North East Inter-State Badminton Championship as precursor to National Games 2027
bullets: The North East Zone Inter-State Badminton Championship 2026 is being held at the Jawaharlal Nehru Indoor Sports Complex in Shillong.
The tournament serves as the official qualifying ground for team events of the upcoming 39th National Games.
Meghalaya highlighted its Meghalaya Outstanding Direct Appointment Policy, which guarantees direct government jobs to state athletes winning medals at major events.

national_news.title: Vice President Leads 79th Hyderabad Liberation Day Commemoration
bullets: The Union Ministry of Culture officially commemorated the 79th Hyderabad Liberation Day at Parade Grounds, Secunderabad, marking the princely state's integration into India via Operation Polo on September 17, 1948.
Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan paid homage at the War Memorial and honored Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel along with regional freedom fighters Ramji Gond, Turrebaz Khan, and Komaram Bheem.
The Central Bureau of Communication under the Ministry of Information & Broadcasting organized a research-based photo exhibition documenting the historic struggle and unification.

national_news.title: Army Chief General Dhiraj Seth Holds Bilateral Defense Talks in Russia
bullets: Chief of Army Staff General Dhiraj Seth conducted a three-day official visit to Russia (September 16–18) to enhance bilateral army-to-army cooperation and joint combat readiness.
General Seth held high-level delegation talks with Russian Land Forces Commander-in-Chief Colonel General Andrei Nikolayevich Mordvichev at the Main Command of Ground Forces in Moscow.
The Indian delegation laid a wreath at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier in Alexander Garden and scheduled visits to Saint Petersburg's Mikhailovskaya Military Artillery Academy.

national_news.title: Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs rolls out Swachhata Hi Seva Campaign 2026
bullets: The Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs participated in the countrywide Swachhata Hi Seva Campaign 2026 held from September 17 to October 2, 2026.
The campaign aims to reinforce cleanliness, hygiene, civic responsibility, and citizen participation for a Swachh Bharat.
Planned activities include cleanliness drives, student awareness programs, felicitation of Safai Mitras, and plantation drives under 'Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam'.

national_news.title: NCB Shifts to Network-Centric Anti-Drug Strategy Under Vision Document 2026-29
bullets: The Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) transitioned from a seizure-centric approach to a network-centric model to dismantle drug trafficking networks and financial channels.
The shift is part of the Vision Document on Narcotics Control 2026-29, which runs from July 2026 to July 2029 with the objective of making India drug-free by 2029.
The roadmap is built on four core pillars: intelligence-based enforcement, synthetic drug control, demand and harm reduction, and capacity building.

national_news.title: PIB, NCB and MHA Detail Anti-Drug Operations and Institutional Expansion
bullets: NCB institutional capacity expanded with manpower increasing from 1,107 to 1,630, zonal units rising from 13 to 36, and regional offices from 3 to 7.
Properties and assets worth ₹3,992 crore have been frozen or seized since 2019, while 128 illegal clandestine laboratories were dismantled up to July 2026.
Major anti-drug operations highlighted include Operation Sagar Manthan (maritime smuggling), Operation Crystal Fortress, Operation Ragepill, and Operation White Strike.

national_news.title: Kashmir Media Delegation Visits Puducherry Lieutenant Governor
bullets: A media delegation from Kashmir on a five-day exposure tour organized by the Press Information Bureau (PIB) interacted with Puducherry LG Kuniyil Kailashnathan.
The Puducherry administration envisions transforming the Union Territory into a major medical tourism hub, backed by seven medical colleges including JIPMER.
Infrastructure expansion projects include extending the airport runway to 2,500 meters and completing railway and roadway expansions by 2028.

national_news.title: PM Modi Chairs Semiconductor Roundtable to Drive Tech Collaboration
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired the Semiconductor Roundtable with global and Indian industry CEOs in New Delhi to outline India's technology roadmap.
Highlighted key priorities including the India Semiconductor Mission 2.0, emerging technologies like AI and Quantum Computing, and a target to skill 1 crore individuals in AI.
Global industry leaders from companies such as Micron, ASML, Intel, Foxconn, and Tata Electronics committed to building capabilities across semiconductor design, manufacturing, and R&D.

bihar_news.title: Taruwar Agro: Turning Bihar's Banana Waste into a Rs 2.5 Crore Enterprise
bullets: Founded by three MBA graduates (Jagat Kalyan, Satyam Kumar, and Nitish Kumar Verma), Taruwar Agro Industries utilizes banana plant waste to manufacture fiber-based products like file folders, yoga mats, and baskets.
The company also produces vermicompost and plant nutrition liquid from remaining plant parts, recording a revenue of approximately Rs 2.5 crore in FY26.
The initiative provides supplemental income to local farmers post-harvest and generates employment opportunities within Bihar.

bihar_news.title: AIMIM Delegation Meets Union Ministers Over Bihar's Seemanchal Infrastructure
bullets: An AIMIM delegation led by MP Asaduddin Owaisi met Union Ministers Nitin Gadkari and Pralhad Joshi to address infrastructure and educational issues in Bihar's Seemanchal region.

The leaders urged the retention of the Morgram–Malda–Murshidabad–Siliguri Four-Lane National Highway alignment through Barsoi in Katihar district and demanded RCC bridges for all-weather river connectivity.
They also requested the establishment of an Eklavya Model Residential School in Katihar and the comprehensive development and funding of the Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) Centre in Kishanganj.

bihar_news.title: Monolithisch India Secures Quartzite Block in Nawada for Rs 157 Crore
bullets: Monolithisch India Limited won a quartzite stone mining block in Nawada district for Rs 157 crore via an e-auction conducted by the Mines and Geology Department of Bihar.
The block provides an approved mining capacity of 35.50 lakh tonnes over a five-year period (7.10 lakh tonnes per annum) to lower raw material procurement costs for silica ramming mass manufacturing.
Commercial mining operations are slated to begin in February-March 2027, with mining activities outsourced to experienced national contractors.

bihar_news.title: SJVN Commissions 660 MW Unit-II of Buxar Thermal Power Project
bullets: SJVN Thermal Private Limited achieved commercial operation of the 660 MW Unit-II of the 1,320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project located at Chausa in Buxar district.
Developed using supercritical technology at an estimated investment of Rs 137.57 billion, the project is SJVN's first fully operational thermal power venture.
The project will generate 9,828.72 million units of electricity annually, with 85 percent allocated to Bihar under a long-term power purchase agreement to boost regional energy security.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Cabinet Approves INR 3,516 Crore for Tourism and Infrastructure Projects in Gaya
bullets: The Bihar Cabinet approved projects worth INR 3,516 crore for Gaya to boost religious, spiritual, and cultural tourism.
An allocation of INR 2,520 crore is designated for the Vishnupad Temple complex development, modelled on the Kashi Vishwanath Corridor.
The INR 996.05-crore Son-Falgu River Linking Project includes building an intake well 23 km upstream from the Indrapuri Barrage.
